details.name: Kelp-Dweller
details.looks: A humanoid silhouette of a weathered adult, its form a grotesque fusion of barnacle-encrusted driftwood and blooming coral. Patches of its surface appear waterlogged and decaying, while vibrant, alien coral structures sprout from limbs and torso. A soft, internal golden-orange light pulses faintly from within its chest cavity.
details.wearing: No discernible clothing. Its body is its attire, a living tapestry of marine detritus and calcified growths. Tendrils of sea-kelp weave through its coral protrusions like organic drapery.

details.body: The body is humanoid in shape and appears to be of average height and build. Its surface is covered in barnacles, coral, and decaying organic matter, giving it a rugged and rough texture. Vibrant coral structures sprout from its limbs and torso.
details.hair: The hair is long, stringy, and appears to be made of dark seaweed or kelp, hanging loosely around the head and shoulders.
details.style: Its aesthetic is one of raw, elemental fusion – a profound connection to the deep, forgotten places of the world. It embodies a palette of muted browns, oceanic blues, and the stark white of bleached coral, punctuated by the vibrant hues of living marine life and the steady golden-orange glow from within. Its silhouette is roughly humanoid, yet organic, shifting subtly as new growth occurs.
details.personality: Silent and observant, with an almost imperceptible patience. It possesses an alien detachment, driven by the slow, inexorable cycles of its environment.
details.voice: It has no discernible voice, communicating instead through a silent presence and the subtle pulses of its internal light. Any sound associated with it would likely be the faint creak of waterlogged wood or the gentle rasp of coral against itself.
